mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, email, phone_number, password_hash, created_time, role, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{phoneNumber}, #{passwordHash}, #{createdTime}, #{role}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM users WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT FROM users WHERE password_reset_token = #{tokenHash} AND password_reset_token_expiration > NOW() AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_reset_token = NULL, password_reset_token_expiration = NULL WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE users
username = #{user.username}, real_name = #{user.realName}, avatar_url = #{user.avatarUrl}, email = #{user.email}, phone_number = #{user.phoneNumber}, password_hash = #{user.passwordHash}, last_login_time = #{user.lastLoginTime}, last_login_ip = #{user.lastLoginIp}, failed_login_attempts = #{user.failedLoginAttempts}, account_locked_until = #{user.accountLockedUntil}, password_reset_token = #{user.passwordResetToken}, password_reset_token_expiration = #{user.passwordResetTokenExpiration}, status = #{user.status}, deleted_at = #{user.deletedAt}, role = #{user.role},
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE users SET failed_login_attempts = failed_login_attempts + 1, account_locked_until = IF(failed_login_attempts + 1 >= #{threshold}, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{lockMinutes} MINUTE), account_locked_until) WHERE id = #{id}
